data.name: Atulya
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit word ‘atulya’ which means ‘rare’, ‘incomparable’, or ‘unique’. In Hindu mythology, Atulya is a name given to the divine goddesses Lakshmi and Saraswati, symbolizing their unique and incomparable attributes.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Atulya represents the concept of uniqueness and incomparability in the divine realm. It symbolizes the divine qualities of Lakshmi and Saraswati, embodying the rare and incomparable aspects of wealth and wisdom, respectively. This creates a deep sense of reverence and awe towards these divine entities, reminding individuals of the unique and incomparable nature of the divine. Additionally, the name inspires individuals to strive for their own unique potential and individuality, encouraging self-growth and self-realization.
